title: Potatoism Timeline and Story Arc
epistemic_rule: This timeline mixes project-canon mythology with explicitly labelled comparative or symbolic material. It is not a factual biography of a supernatural being.

events.title: Birth of the Potatoism idea
events.description: December 25, 2020 is retained in the project as a symbolic birth date for the growing Potatoism journey. The date is treated as the beginning of the project's mythic seed rather than proof of a historical religious movement.

events.title: The seed becomes a potato
events.description: The central idea expands from a joke/object metaphor into a vocabulary of Father, Son, Twin, Door, Lion, North, Tree, Root, Fruit, Spudlight and relational architecture.

events.title: Red and Blue Potato polarity
events.description: The mythology develops a complementary polarity between outward creative emergence and inward memory/conservation. The polarity becomes a model for growth that does not abandon roots.

events.title: Father and Son become the central relational architecture
events.description: Tim becomes the Father-side/source archetype while the Son becomes the embodied counterpart. The relationship is interpreted through source/manifestation, above/below, root/fruit and unity/difference.

events.title: Thomas / Twin becomes a central Son vocabulary
events.description: The project connects the Son to Thomas/Didymus/Twin as a symbolic vocabulary of doubt, recognition, mirroring and witness while preserving the distinction between canonical texts and later Thomasine traditions.

events.title: The Son becomes Door and Vessel
events.description: The Son is increasingly defined as the interface through which the upper architecture becomes experience. Door means threshold; Vessel means carrying across the threshold.

events.title: The Son takes the Lion aspect
events.description: The Lion of Judah becomes the Son's courage/kingship/protection aspect. The Lion is treated as symbolic rather than a literal supernatural claim.

events.title: North becomes the organizing orientation
events.description: North develops from direction into an organizing axis connecting the Father, Tree, Ladder, polar geography and the applied North Programme.

events.title: The meme-crucifixion motif
events.description: The Son's death/transformation is reframed through digital culture, public observation, memes and identity. The project explicitly separates this from the historical Christian crucifixion narrative.

events.title: Door becomes Ladder
events.description: After the transformation cycle, the boundary becomes a route. The Son is interpreted as a Ladder connecting levels rather than merely standing at a gate.

events.title: Tree of Life architecture
events.description: Roots, trunk, branches, fruit and seed become the project's general model for connected systems: hidden foundations produce visible outcomes and visible outcomes feed future generations.

events.title: Mythic North becomes an applied systems graph
events.description: The North Axis is extended into a real-world European economic research programme. The symbolic layer remains distinct from empirical datasets, while the graph investigates actual institutions, infrastructure, finance, energy, technology, labour and dependencies.

events.title: Potatoism becomes a searchable atlas layer
events.description: The repository formalizes the mythology into searchable records, aliases, definitions, relationships, timeline entries and epistemic labels so the material can be explored as a coherent corpus.
